name: Swarm of Bats
classification: Medium swarm of Tiny beasts, unaligned
appearance: A loose cloud of small brown bats with pointed ears and spread, leathery wings.
otherStatistics: Proficiency bonus +2. Blindsight 60 ft., passive Perception 11. Resists bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage. Immune to charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained and stunned. No listed languages.

sections.Printed source:
Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual (2014), Appendix A, p. 337. Official online reference: https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/17028-swarm-of-bats
Monster Manual errata v2.0, p. 2, adds grappled immunity to all swarms on pp. 337–339.
sections.Traits:
Echolocation. The swarm loses the use of blindsight while deafened.
Keen Hearing. It has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks based on hearing.
Swarm. This swarm and another creature can occupy the same space. It can pass through openings that fit one Tiny bat. It cannot regain HP or gain temporary HP.
sections.Actions: Bites. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm’s space. On a hit, deal 5 (2d4) piercing damage above half maximum HP or 2 (1d4) piercing damage at half maximum HP or less.
sections.At the table: With the printed 22 HP maximum, use the lower piercing damage at 11 HP or less.

name: Swarm of Poisonous Snakes
classification: Medium swarm of Tiny beasts, unaligned
appearance: A close tangle of small olive-brown snakes with patterned scales and raised heads.
otherStatistics: Proficiency bonus +2. Blindsight 10 ft., passive Perception 10. Resists bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage. Immune to charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained and stunned. No listed languages.

sections.Printed source:
Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual (2014), Appendix A, p. 338. Official online reference: https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/17030-swarm-of-poisonous-snakes
Monster Manual errata v2.0, p. 2, adds grappled immunity to all swarms on pp. 337–339.
sections.Traits: Swarm. This swarm and another creature can occupy the same space. It can pass through openings that fit one Tiny snake. It cannot regain HP or gain temporary HP.
sections.Actions: Bites. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm’s space. On a hit, deal 7 (2d6) piercing damage above half maximum HP or 3 (1d6) piercing damage at half maximum HP or less. The target also rolls a DC 10 Constitution save. It takes 14 (4d6) poison damage on a failure or half on a success. Use these poison dice at either swarm HP tier.
sections.At the table: With the printed 36 HP maximum, use the lower piercing damage at 18 HP or less. The swarm’s HP tier changes the piercing component only.
